titulo: Discurso indireto: perguntas, pedidos e ordens: Revisão e prática da aula 48

aula.titulo: Discurso indireto: perguntas, pedidos e ordens
aula.objetivo: Relatar perguntas (com «if/whether» e palavras interrogativas), pedidos e ordens («asked me to», «told me not to»), e perguntar de forma indireta e educada.

opcoes: She asked where did I live
She asked me where I live

itens.audio: He told me not to be late
opcoes: He told me not to be late
He told me to not be late
He said me not to be late
itens.gabarito: He told me not to be late

itens.audio: She asked if I was tired
itens.respostaEsperada: She asked if I was tired
itens.explicacao: Escreva: she asked if I was tired.

itens.audio: Could you tell me where the station is
itens.respostaEsperada: Could you tell me where the station is
itens.explicacao: Escreva: could you tell me where the station is.

opcoes: She asked where did I live.
She asked where I do live.

itens.enunciado: Qual frase relata uma ordem negativa?
opcoes: She told me not to be late.
She told me don't be late.
She said me not be late.
itens.gabarito: She told me not to be late.

itens.enunciado: Qual palavra liga uma pergunta de sim/não?
Qual é a pergunta educada correta?
opcoes: Could you tell me where the station is?
Could you tell me where is the station?
Could you tell me where does the station?
itens.gabarito: Could you tell me where the station is?

itens.enunciado: He told me ___ close the door. (para)
She told me ___ to be late. (não)
Ordene: «She asked me where I worked.»
itens.gabarito: She asked me where I worked.

itens.enunciado: Ordene: «He told me to close the door.»
itens.gabarito: He told me to close the door.

itens.enunciado: Escreva 4 frases no indireto: uma pergunta sim/não, uma com palavra interrogativa, uma ordem afirmativa e uma ordem negativa.
itens.respostaEsperada: She asked if I was tired. She asked where I lived. He told me to close the door. She told me not to be late.

blocos.enunciado: Conte em 1 minuto uma conversa recente com perguntas, ordens e pedidos no indireto.
Relate uma conversa curta, com perguntas, pedidos e ordens.
